presets.name: Sixties germanium
presets.desc: The germanium face at full fuzz, single coil loading its input: warm, round, not fizzy

refs.why: germanium two-transistor fuzz into a clean-ish stack

presets.notes: The reference face: the pickup's coil and pots in front of Q1 take the top off before anything clips

presets.name: Volume-knob clean
presets.desc: Full fuzz; roll the guitar volume (EXP) to 30 % for a bright, nearly clean tone at the same level
presets.notes: Measured: THD −7 dB at 100 %, −17 at 50 %, −23 at 30 % with the level within 2.5 dB; put EXP on guitar_vol

presets.name: Behind a buffer
presets.desc: The same face after a buffer: the volume knob only turns it down, the fuzz stays
presets.notes: To hear why a face wants to be first: buffered, the THD is 5 – 13 dB higher at every knob position

presets.name: Summer stage
presets.desc: Hot germanium at 35 °C: the face drifts off bias, thinner and splattier
presets.notes: Q2's collector moves 4.5 → 6.7 V (bias_v): less swing towards the supply

presets.name: Winter garage
presets.desc: Cold germanium at 12 °C: the face sinks towards saturation, darker and more compressed
presets.notes: bias_v about 3 V: Q2 nearer saturation

presets.name: Leaky pair
presets.desc: An unselected germanium pair (250 % leakage): biased high, thin and spitty
presets.notes: The pedal a builder would have rejected: Q2 sits near 6.5 V

presets.name: Misbiased spitter
presets.desc: The trimmer turned down (bias −70 %): Q2 near saturation, sputter on the decay
presets.notes: bias_v ≈ 1 V; which side gates best is for the ear (README §2.6)

presets.name: Starved gate
presets.desc: A dying 4 V battery with sag on the germanium face: notes chop off as they decay
presets.notes: The README's velcro gate is a silicon face (not shipped yet); on germanium the bias follows the supply: splattier than gated

presets.name: Dying battery
presets.desc: Put EXP on voltage and sweep 9 → 3 V: from full fuzz to a broken, sputtering gate

presets.name: Parallel fuzz
presets.desc: Germanium face blended 50 / 50 with the dry guitar: fuzz on top, the attack kept

presets.name: Swell fuzz
presets.desc: Put EXP on fuzz: the face's own pot swept under the foot, from boost-like to full fuzz

presets.name: Wall of sustain
presets.desc: Four-transistor muff, classic stack at noon: endless sustain with the mid scoop

refs.why: muff-type fuzz walls on 90s alternative records

presets.name: Doom wall
presets.desc: Russian stack, sustain high, tone towards the bass, a little mids: dark and thick

presets.name: Band-mix muff
presets.desc: Muff with the scoop filled (mids 80 %): stays audible in a band mix
presets.notes: 22 kΩ-class resistor in series with the low-pass cap: the notch shrinks and moves down

presets.name: Tone-bypassed muff
presets.desc: The muff with its tone stack removed: loud, flat and mid-heavy

presets.name: Eighteen-volt muff
presets.desc: The muff on an 18 V supply: more headroom, louder and less compressed

presets.name: Triangle lead
presets.desc: Early-1970s triangle-era stack, sustain 80 %, tone a touch bright: a singing lead

presets.name: Fuzz bass
presets.desc: Russian muff for bass: below 120 Hz the dry stays, a 70 % blend keeps the fundamental
